_meta.title: Mined grapheme-phoneme correspondences (empirical)
_meta.description: Frequency-ordered phoneme(s) per grapheme, conditioned by position, mined by code from CMUdict via G2PAligner. Aggregate letter statistics (a property of the letter), NOT a whole-word pronunciation lookup. Empirical companion to the hand-seeded gpc-table.json.
_meta.source: CMUdict (Carnegie Mellon Pronouncing Dictionary, permissive) — aggregate frequencies only; see data/PROVENANCE.md
_meta.method: Monotonic grapheme<->phoneme alignment (G2PAligner); words with per-phoneme alignment cost > 0.6 excluded as noisy (e.g. opaque -tion morphemes). ARPAbet folded to coarse IPA.
_meta.notation: coarse IPA (stress dropped, vowel length folded, r-controlled split into vowel+r). Positions: initial | medial | final.
